headline: Stlican Shelf and DeadLands Reopen; Weathered Expanse Calms
war_summary: Since the previous edition the battle line has shifted once more. Stlican Shelf, quiet at the last bulletin, has rekindled with three strategic-base ownership changes in the final two-hour window and twenty-nine on the day. DeadLands has extended its stirring, posting two flips in the closing pair of hours, with Callahan's Boot the busiest ground. Weathered Expanse, the day's most eventful map, has gone quiet at the two-hour mark—its last flip came at 19:53—yet it still shows thirty-six changes in twenty-four hours and the heaviest casualty totals. Godcrofts, also active at the last report, has not produced a fresh flip since 19:42. King's Cage and Loch Mor each recorded two flips within the six-hour returns. Elsewhere Farranac Coast, Stonecradle, Fisherman's Row, Callahan's Passage, and Linn Mercy remain without fresh strategic-base flips. Casualty returns continue high across Weathered Expanse, DeadLands, Stlican Shelf, Loch Mor, and Stonecradle. No victory has been declared.
